keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Mateus Mané (Wolverhampton Wanderers) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Wolverhampton Wanderers 0, Bolton Wanderers 1. Atsuki Ito (Bolton Wanderers) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner following a corner.
Gaizka Larrazabal (Bolton Wanderers) is shown the yellow card.
Second Half begins Wolverhampton Wanderers 0, Bolton Wanderers 1.

Goal! Wolverhampton Wanderers 1, Bolton Wanderers 1. Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolverhampton Wanderers) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Ladislav Krejcí.
Substitution, Wolverhampton Wanderers. Rafiki Saïd replaces Mateus Mané.
Substitution, Bolton Wanderers. Jayden Nelson replaces Samuel Iling-Junior.
Substitution, Bolton Wanderers. Rúben Rodrigues replaces Atsuki Ito.
Substitution, Bolton Wanderers. Sam Dalby replaces Theo Bair.
Goal! Wolverhampton Wanderers 1, Bolton Wanderers 2. Sam Dalby (Bolton Wanderers) left footed shot from very close range to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Gaizka Larrazabal.
Ethan Erhahon (Bolton Wanderers) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Bolton Wanderers. Xavier Simons replaces Ethan Erhahon.
Substitution, Bolton Wanderers. Max Conway replaces Thierry Gale.
